Visiting the Coastline Museum

The museum is open Tuesday to Sunday, from 10am to 5pm. It is closed on Mondays, except bank holidays.

Entry is free, but the special exhibition on shipwrecks costs 8 pounds for adults and 4 pounds for children.

The café is on the ground floor, and lockers are available near the entrance for a 1 pound coin.

Guided tours start at 11am and 2pm and last about an hour.
